expense_payments_reversal_ck.name: expense_payments_reversal_ck
expense_payments_reversal_ck.value: ("expense_payments"."reverses_id" is null) = ("expense_payments"."amount" > 0) and ("expense_payments"."reverses_id" is null or "expense_payments"."reason" is not null)

payments_reversal_ck.name: payments_reversal_ck
payments_reversal_ck.value: ("payments"."kind" = 'reversal') = ("payments"."reverses_payment_id" is not null) and ("payments"."kind" <> 'reversal' or "payments"."reason" is not null)

sales_documents_issued_ck.name: sales_documents_issued_ck
sales_documents_issued_ck.value: "sales_documents"."status" = 'draft' or ("sales_documents"."issue_date" is not null and "sales_documents"."content_hash" is not null and "sales_documents"."issued_at" is not null and "sales_documents"."fiscal_year" is not null)
